data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 5.5m (2013: GBP 4.2m) includes a deterioration of GBP 0.3m on 2012 & prior years and a marginal movement on the other years of account (2013: GBP 1.4m deterioration) in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end. The unfavourable development on the 2012 & prior years follows adverse experience in relation to the Syndicate's long-tailed legacy portfolio.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on long-tailed legacy portfolio
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on 2012 & prior years resulting in a deterioration of GBP 0.3m

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 17.603m. During 2014 there was an adverse development on prior years, driven by the Syndicate's long-tailed legacy portfolio, resulting in a gross deterioration of GBP 0.3m (approximately 1.7% of opening gross claims outstanding). This movement is treated as a prior-year strengthening of reserves, primarily affecting the Syndicate's life/accident & health business.
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of GBP 0.3m on 2012 & prior years
marginal movement on the other years of account (2013: GBP 1.4m deterioration)
The unfavourable development on the 2012 & prior years follows adverse experience in relation to the Syndicate's long-tailed legacy portfolio
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities) comparative 2013 column. Prior-year development figure derived from narrative in claims note stating a GBP 0.3m deterioration on 2012 & prior years. No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross table was found; the reported GBP 0.3m is stated within the P&L/claims note narrative. No claims development triangle or per-LOB prior-year movement breakdown is present in the available text. Confidence in the prior-year movement is moderate (0.8) as the amount is explicit but presented in the context of 'claims incurred' narrative.
